description: 三次「世界有多小」的測量：兩人之間平均要走幾步（距離）

source.text: Travers & Milgram 1969（Sociometry）；Backstrom 等人 2012（arXiv:1111.4570）；Facebook Research 2016（部落格）
source.sample: Milgram：296 位起點者、64 條成功的鏈；Facebook 2011：約 7.21 億位用戶、690 億條友誼；Facebook 2016：15.9 億位用戶

points.label: 成功的 64 條鏈；論文報告中間人 5.2 位，距離 = 5.2 + 1
points.source: Travers & Milgram 1969, Sociometry 32(4), p. 425（摘要）：mean number of intermediaries … is 5.2（換算成距離 +1）

points.label: 全球約 7.21 億人
points.source: Backstrom et al. 2012, arXiv:1111.4570, 摘要：The average distance we observe is 4.74, corresponding to 3.74 intermediaries

points.label: 全球 15.9 億人
points.source: Facebook Research 2016, Three and a half degrees of separation：The average distance we observe is 4.57, corresponding to 3.57 intermediaries

facts.milgram_source: Travers & Milgram 1969：N = 296；217 of the 296 starting persons actually sent the document；64 of the folders, or 29 per cent of those sent out … reached the target；48 per cent of the chains passing through three persons before reaching the target
facts.fb2011_source: Backstrom et al. 2012, arXiv:1111.4570, 摘要
facts.fb2016_source: Facebook Research 2016, Three and a half degrees of separation：Within the US, people are connected to each other by an average of 3.46 degrees
